head_note: Neural-gaps lane N3 (2026-10-09): LayerNorm device I/O for the class (default ON, env before arm), kept forward stats (default ON, env before arm), and the IDENTICAL 32-lane row fold (default OFF, bits change, the gridded switch)

ln_row_warp.status: promoted 2026-10-10 (lane/postmerge-act-6; post-merge neural A/B, one run per arm, nv2 L40S v1056 -> v1057 on main 9f83ea479, amd MI325X a1156 -> a1157 on main 0a7b206f1): IDENTICAL default; the old on-define is refused in core/six_lane_experiment_guards.mojo
ln_row_warp.note: IDENTICAL only. The LayerNorm forward (sum x, sum (x - mean)^2) and backward-x (sum g, sum g xhat) row reductions as fold32's 32-slot order: logical lane j folds c = j, j + 32, ... ascending from +0.0, then the five-level pairwise tree (tree32). Device: the coop warp cell (coop_ln_fwd_rw / coop_ln_bwd_x_rw, shuffle_xor strides 16..1, inside a 32-lane half on CDNA); one-thread op and host twin: the same slots and tree32. BITS CHANGE against main's one-chain row on NVIDIA, AMD and host together; dweight / dbias folds unchanged. Cost: the one-chain row is D dependent adds per reduction (latency-bound at any D >= 32); the fold is D/32 + 5. ID check nv/amd owed before the A/B. Reaches neural:layernorm (and any LayerNorm user). PROMOTED: layernorm NV 1.394 -> 1.071 ms (0.77x) / AMD 1.446 -> 1.143 ms (0.79x); digest 5fe9165c -> 2a8100a0 on BOTH vendors (bits change; every LayerNorm row in IDENTICAL, host twin with it). The off arm restores the one-chain row.

ln_class_device_io_off.status: confirmed:postmerge-20261010 (lane/postmerge-act-6; post-merge neural A/B, one run per arm (nv2 L40S v1052/v1056 defaults on main 9f83ea479, amd MI325X a1152/a1156 on main 0a7b206f1)): class device IO stays the default (neutral)
ln_class_device_io_off.note: Python-shell ENVIRONMENT switch, not a build define (the planner's define arms do not reach it; A/B by ENV=MOJOLEARN_LN_CLASS_DEVICE_IO_OFF=1 on the race line). Default ON (absent): mojolearn.LayerNorm reports _device_io and has to_device, so the board's generic layer path (and any caller who uploads x once) takes the resident entry layer_norm_dev: no x upload, y download, x + dy upload, dx download inside the clock (4 x M x D floats per fit) and no page-faulted zero fills. Same launches on the same values: no bits. MOJOLEARN_SEQ_DEVICE_IO_OFF=1 and MOJOLEARN_IDN_ALL_OFF=1 also turn it off. CONFIRMED 2026-10-10 (env arm): layernorm NV 1.394 -> 1.341 ms (0.96x, v1062) / AMD 1.446 -> 1.488 ms (1.03x, a1150): neutral, average 1.00x; digest 5fe9165c unchanged. Kept: no reason to move.

ln_keep_stats_off.note: Python-shell ENVIRONMENT switch (A/B by ENV=MOJOLEARN_LN_KEEP_STATS_OFF=1 on the race line). Default ON (absent): a resident LayerNorm.forward stores its row mean / rstd in two kept M-float resident tensors and backward passes them (6-handle layer_norm_dev, ip[5] = 1), so the device entry skips the forward recompute: one OP_LN_FWD launch over M x D and an M x D scratch y fewer per backward. The stats are the forward's own stores: no bits. Only reached with the class on resident x (the functional layer_norm_backward recomputes as before).
